prompt:
Create pixel-art pieces for a modern 16-bit-style top-down RPG town map (three-quarter overhead view, like a classic SNES JRPG town).

Image 1 is a PLACEMENT GUIDE on a magenta page: fill each grey box edge to edge with the piece described for it. Do not copy the grey colour.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: the approved walking sprite of a character from this game at the same pixel scale as the map (about 90 sprite pixels tall). Match its sprite-pixel size, its outlines and its flat 2-3 tone shading with light from the upper left.

Image 3 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 4 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.

Pieces:
- the top-left box (96x96 sprite pixels): a strip that repeats SEAMLESSLY left to right (its top and bottom edges are real edges). the outer front wall of a royal castle keep seen straight from the front: large pale cream-grey dressed ashlar stone blocks in even courses with thin dark joints, and one carved stone string-course band running across the middle, evenly repeating left to right; no windows, no doors, no edges.
- the top-centre box (96x96 sprite pixels): a SEAMLESS texture (left edge continues into the right edge, top into bottom). a castle roof seen from the front at a steep angle: dark blue-grey slate tiles in neat overlapping horizontal courses with a few lighter and darker slates, evenly spread, no ridge, no edges.
- the middle-left box (96x96 sprite pixels): a SEAMLESS texture (left edge continues into the right edge, top into bottom). the polished floor of a royal castle hall seen from straight above: a checkerboard of cream and soft grey marble squares, four squares across the box and four down, with fine veins and thin dark joints, evenly spread.
- the middle-centre box (96x96 sprite pixels): a strip that repeats SEAMLESSLY left to right (its top and bottom edges are real edges). the inside wall of a royal castle hall seen straight from the front: pale grey dressed stone blocks in the upper three quarters, a dark red-brown carved wooden wainscot panel along the bottom quarter, and a thin carved stone cornice along the top edge; no windows, no doors, evenly repeating left to right.

Draw each piece as one continuous picture with no lines dividing it into squares. Render as true pixel art: every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. Between the boxes: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF), no text.
